author: ETA PRIME
description:
The handheld gaming market is in serious trouble. RAM and storage prices have skyrocketed thanks to massive AI data center buildouts, and it's hitting portable gaming hard. Ayaneo suspended the Next 2, Retroid discontinued multiple devices, and even Steam Deck production is being limited. In this video, we break down every cancellation, price hike, and delay — and what it means for handheld gaming going forward.

🔹 Ayaneo Next 2 suspended — production costs nearly doubled
🔹 Retroid Pocket 6 12GB discontinued, Pocket G2 pulled from shelves
🔹 Price hikes across Retroid, Anbernic, and more
🔹 Steam Deck LCD dropped, Steam Machine delayed
🔹 What's still coming: Legion Go 2, ROG Ally X updates, and more
